section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Executive Function (EF) battery used in the study, which comprised six measures across three EFs: response inhibition (Antisaccade, Stroop), working memory updating (Keep Track, Letter Memory), and set shifting (Number-Letter, Category Switch). It briefly discusses the tasks, dependent measures, and scoring procedures, noting that two tasks within each EF were averaged for composite scores, and an overall EF score was computed by averaging these z-scored composites. The text also mentions specific data exclusion criteria for trials and one participant.
